title: Resonance-cluster analysis for a proposed counterexample to Fried's conjecture
summary: A Lean 4 formalization of the theorem FriedCrossing.fried_counterexample_of_resolvent_inputs, the machine-checked reduction behind a proposed codimension-one failure of Fried's identity ζ(0) = τ_R for acyclic characters on a closed hyperbolic 3-manifold with b₁ = 1. For a simple illustration of the method with figures, see docs/counterexample_intuitive_view.pdf. review.reason: Lean formalization of a reduction for a proposed counterexample to Fried's conjecture.
